description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with strong front-end expertise in React and practical back-end experience with Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will build responsive, intuitive web applications; integrate user interfaces with scalable services and databases; and collaborate with product, design, quality assurance, and engineering partners to deliver reliable software. The ideal candidate combines sound engineering practices with strong user-experience awareness, analytical problem-solving, and attention to detail.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design, develop, test, and deploy responsive, accessible, and visually consistent user interfaces using React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Translate wireframes, mockups, and product requirements into reusable, maintainable front-end components.
 Develop and maintain back-end APIs and services using Java and Spring Boot.
 Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
 Write and optimize SQL queries to support application functionality, performance, and data integrity.
 Improve application speed, scalability, reliability, and usability through performance analysis and sound engineering practices.
 Collaborate with product managers, designers, quality assurance professionals, and engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.
 Use Git, npm, and related development tools to maintain code quality, version control, and build automation.
 Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, and contribute to continuous product improvement.
 Participate in Agile planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives.
 Stay current with modern front-end, back-end, cloud, and user-experience practices.
 
 Three or more years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands-on front-end development experience.
 Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Experience with Node.js and npm-based development workflows.
 Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, including the ability to implement and maintain straightforward back-end APIs.
 Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write efficient, well-structured database queries.
 Experience integrating web applications with RESTful APIs; GraphQL experience is also welcome.
 Proficiency with Git or a comparable version-control platform.
 Strong understanding of responsive design, usability, browser compatibility, and front-end performance.
 Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 One or more years of experience working in an Agile software development environment.
 Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
 Familiarity with AWS or another cloud platform.
 Experience with browser debugging, profiling, and performance-testing tools.
 Knowledge of secure coding practices, API authentication, and scalable application design.
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 
 Acumatica is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail  HR@acumatica.com . This email is created exclusively to assist disabled job seekers whose disability prevents them from being able to apply online. Only emails sent for this purpose will be returned. Emails sent for other purposes, such as following up on an application or technical issues not related to a disability, will not receive a response. 
 For this role, the salary range is $115,000-130,000 annually. This range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job and may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant elements.
 At Acumatica, certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.
 Benefits/perks listed here may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Acumatica and the country where you work. US-based employees gain access to healthcare benefits (medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents), employer paid Short-Term/Long-Term Disability and Basic life coverage, 401(k) plan with company match, Flexible time off, sick and safe leave, among others.
